html.html: How do you write  6.2 × 103 in standard form?

content.html: The power of 10 tells you how many places to the right to move the decimal point.

html.html: How do you write  6.2 × 103 in standard form?

content.html:
You want to move the decimal point 3 places to the right. First, write extra zeros to the right of the decimal point. Remember that writing extra zeros to the right of a decimal does not change its value.

6.2 = 6.200


Now move the decimal point 3 places to the right.

6.200 → 6,200.

6.2 × 103 = 6,200
